scope: Painted ordinary enemies and three Workshop optional repair machines

rubric.note: Brute forks, Pilgrim tank and Spitter furnace distinguish the new families.
Rust and brass actors match the arena; the unchanged Saint retains its graphic treatment.
Fixed views preserve painted highlights; camera angles vary slightly across assets.
Major shapes survive downscaling; fine surface details are dense.
Directional charge lines and support radii remain visible around painted bodies.
Belt, pump and gong are recognizable distinct fixtures.
Hardware changes are subtle at 64 pixels; progress, labels and checkmarks explain state.
Marked and quieted overlays remain separable from the sprite.
Decorative body movement and sparks stop; essential state and threat cues persist.
Actual renderer fixtures and state-hash checks; no human playtest claimed.

limitation: Fixed-view flattened sprites, not articulated or directional gait. Fine repair details are subtle at gameplay scale; state markers carry completion clarity. Bosses, elite and destination objectives remain procedural. Human 1x readability testing remains outstanding.
next_task: Give the Memory Crane and Foreman Engine painted bodies and state-driven mechanical animation.
